summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K containing a Q1 2026 trading update. The update reports underlying group sales up 4%, with all business units performing in line with expectations and reaffirmation of 2026 full-year guidance. The filing mentions a £350m share buyback programme progressing well, with £219m of shares repurchased at an average price of 964p per share as of March 31, 2026, and a successful issuance of a £350m 10-year bond in April 2026. However, these capital allocation activities are routine and not part of a special-situation event like a tender offer, issuer tender, or capital return program. The filing is a standard periodic business update with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or strategic review elements. There are no deal terms or recommended actions.
